notes.title: Patch Me Up, Doc! (#1)
notes.content:
Greetings, my plump little muffins. We put out a quick patch just now with some small but notable changes!

[list]
[*]Fixed a rare crash that can occur when dying at the exact moment an enemy spawns.
[*]Saves should now always properly update as you play, not just when you close the game.
[*]Added a Hints notification if you die to the same thing a few times.
[*]Decreased the hitbox on the Targets found in the Chocco & Pugnacious boss fight.
[*]Lowered a beater found in the C&P boss fight to stop some frustrating deaths.
[/list]

Let us know if you encounter any odd issues with anything!
 - The Mega Dwarfs

notes.title: Shank n' Bake is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29491031/3265ca346cf6be6389144000c3220af500bf0a3c.gif[/img]

Hello there, my beautiful succulent muffins! Shank n' Bake is finally out. As in you could be slashing, smashing, tearing, and jabbing your way through the world of healthy foods right now!

Be sure to let us know what you think of the game (or if you encounter any nasty bugs that need fixing), as your feedback is wildly important to us.

Thank you all for your support and have fun!
- The Mega Dwarfs

notes.title: Shank n' Bake Feedback Tests! Sign up now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29491031/9dcabdf363a2693f0b71522d024e5dfb3161a137.gif[/img]

Hello again!

Since we've overhauled the game so much, we want to show off a slice of it to some users and get some valuable feedback!

All you have to do is simply sign up to the mailing list here: https://mailchi.mp/e648df4f3baa/shanknbake
And once we close the entries (roughly a week), you'll be emailed a Steam Beta Key you can redeem and start playing!

Along with the key, you will receive a link to a mini survey you can quickly fill out, or just email us with your honest, maybe even sometimes harsh, feedback!

Thanks to everyone who signs up!

Love you!
- The Mega Dwarfs
